instruction: Retrieve deleted layers using the editing history and save them as separate files.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because JPEG files do not store layer information or editing history. JPEGs are flattened, compressed raster images that merge all visual data into a single layer. Layer data and editing history are only preserved in native project formats like GIMP's XCF format or Photoshop's PSD format. There are no deleted layers to recover from this JPEG file.
